key_issues.title: Integrity Commissioner Fired After Finding Mayor Breached Code of Conduct
key_issues.description: Integrity Commissioner Tony Fleming found Mayor Mitch Panciuk violated code of conduct by interfering in city hiring process, directing staff to shortlist unqualified candidates. Council voted not to implement penalties (public reprimand + 30-day pay suspension). Then voted 5-3 to fire Fleming. Only one bid received for replacement.

key_issues.title: Strong Mayor Powers — Democratic Accountability Concerns
key_issues.description: Mayor Neil Ellis stated he plans to use Ontario strong mayor powers to secure provincial funding. Council passed motion opposing the powers, arguing they undermine democratic checks. Belleville exceeded 2023 housing target by 284%, receiving $1.2M from Building Faster Fund directed to $55M Avonlough Sewage Pumping Station.

key_issues.title: Neil Ellis Federal Career — MP Bay of Quinte 2015-2019
key_issues.description: Neil Ellis served as Liberal MP for Bay of Quinte 2015-2019. As MP he received lobbying contacts and participated in parliamentary committees. Now serves as mayor with knowledge of federal-municipal procurement pipelines. Potential revolving door from federal politics to municipal governance.

key_issues.title: CFB Trenton Connection — CFNIS Investigation Area
key_issues.description: CFB Trenton (8 Wing) is located in Quinte West, directly adjacent to Belleville. The base is the hub for Canadian Forces operations and is within the CFNIS investigation jurisdiction documented in the TENET5 accountability database. Military personnel and families are a significant portion of the local population and economy.
